summary: Students who wish to take 2026 winter session courses must register during the course registration period, 27 October to 3 November 2026 (excluding Saturdays and Sundays). They must then print the tuition bill and pay by bank or virtual account within the payment periods (first period 18–23 November 2026, final period 26–27 November 2026), or their registration will be cancelled automatically. Registration uses the course registration system; the attached guidelines and manuals were not read and should be consulted.
applies_to: Students who wish to take courses in the 2026 winter session. The notice does not say that registration is mandatory. The rule against retaking courses currently being taken in Fall 2026 applies to undergraduate students. Expected graduates must check their graduation requirements and register within the period.

dates.what: Tuition bill printing and tuition payment, first period
Tuition bill printing and tuition payment, final period

conditions: If tuition is not paid by bank payment or virtual account within the payment period, the course registration is cancelled automatically.
Course registration is not open on Saturdays and Sundays during the registration period.
Under the anti-course-reselling system, courses cannot be dropped during the time slots when vacated seats are opened for first-come registration, in both the registration and change periods.
Students may register for a maximum of 9 credits, including credits taken through credit exchange at other domestic universities.
Undergraduate students may not retake in the winter session a course they are currently taking in Fall 2026.
Expected graduates must first confirm whether they meet the graduation requirements and must complete registration within the period.
Over-capacity (beyond enrollment limit) requests and course cancellations must be completed within the stated periods; no changes are possible after the periods end.
steps: Read the attachments: the 2026 winter session registration guideline, the course registration system user manual, the anti-reselling card news, the notice on registration misconduct, and the course overlap request manual (these attachments were not read for this translation).
Expected graduates: confirm whether you meet the graduation requirements before registering.
Take part in preliminary course registration from 20 to 23 October 2026 if you wish.
Register for courses in the course registration system from 27 October to 3 November 2026 (weekdays only), up to 9 credits.
Make any changes to your registration from 11 to 13 November 2026, following the over-capacity request procedure if needed.
Print the tuition bill and pay tuition by bank or virtual account from 18 to 23 November 2026, or at the latest in the final period from 26 to 27 November 2026.
If you need to cancel a course, do so between 11 December 2026 and 7 January 2027.
translation:
2026 Winter Session Course Registration Guide

A. Schedule

Item | Period | Remarks
Preliminary course registration | Tue 20 Oct – Fri 23 Oct 2026 |
Course registration | Tue 27 Oct – Tue 3 Nov 2026 | Excluding Saturdays and Sundays
Course registration changes | Wed 11 Nov – Fri 13 Nov 2026 |
Tuition bill printing and tuition payment | (First) Wed 18 Nov – Mon 23 Nov 2026; (Final) Thu 26 Nov – Fri 27 Nov 2026 | If not paid by bank payment or virtual account, course registration is automatically cancelled
Course registration cancellation | Fri 11 Dec 2026 – Thu 7 Jan 2027 |

B. Important Notes

Anti-course-reselling system: During first-come course registration and course registration changes, courses cannot be dropped during the time slots for registering for vacated seats.

Class period and credit limit: Tue 22 Dec 2026 – Mon 25 Jan 2027; maximum 9 credits (including credit exchange with other domestic universities).

Registration and retaking: Courses being taken in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기) cannot be retaken in the winter session (applies to undergraduate students).

Registration by expected graduates: Check in advance whether you meet the graduation requirements, and you must complete registration within the period.

Over-capacity requests and course cancellation: Familiarise yourself with the procedures and you must complete them within the period (no changes after the period).

Attachments:
1. 2026 Winter Session Course Registration Guide materials, one copy each.
2. Notice regarding course registration misconduct, one copy.
3. Notice on duplicate (overlapping) course registration, one copy. End.

Attached files (5): (Attachment 1-1) Guideline for 2026 Winter Session Course Registration (PDF); (Attachment 1-2) Seoul National University Course Registration System User Manual (Korean/English) (PDF); (Attachment 1-3) Card news: New CRS Program for Preventing Reselling (PDF); (Attachment 2) Notice regarding course registration misconduct (PDF); (Attachment 3) Course Overlap Request Manual (PDF). The contents of these attachments were not read for this translation. For questions, contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.
